title: Death Countdown
next_chapter_hook: "That loophole was so tiny it could almost be ignored, but Chen Ji's pupils suddenly contracted—the fatal flaw in destiny was actually hidden here."

text.content: "The night wind cut like a blade across Chen Ji's cheek. He stood alone at the Cliff of the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain, below was an abyss of ten thousand feet, above was the crescent moon obscured by dark clouds. Ling Yuan's departing silhouette had vanished into the night's end, but that voice coiled around his heart like a venomous snake—the Death Executioner was already en route. He slowly spread open his palm, and the Tianji Record Fragment shimmered with a ghostly blue glow under the moonlight, as if sensing its master's inner turmoil, and began turning pages on its own."

"The rustling sound of pages turning was especially clear in the silent night. Chen Ji held his breath, waiting for that familiar yet terrifying residual soul of Mo Xiansheng to appear. However, this time the fragment did not stop on any page, but flipped frantically, papers rattling, the ghostly blue light growing brighter and brighter, as if something long sealed was breaking free. Mo Xiansheng's phantom finally emerged, but his expression was more grave than ever before. Those illusory eyes stared directly at Chen Ji, seemingly hesitating whether to speak the words to come."

"Chen Ji's heart contracted violently. Chapter Seven Hundred—that was a realm he had never touched. The Tianji Record's prophecies were divided into a thousand chapters. The first seven hundred chapters recorded things destined to happen, while the final three hundred chapters were forbidden grounds of fate, beyond even his ability to窥探. He took a deep breath, focusing all his attention on the glowing fragment. Characters flowed forth like water, engraving themselves word by word into his eyes, each character weighing a thousand pounds, pressing down until he could barely breathe. The ink on the fragment seemed to come alive, twisting and reforming under the moonlight, eventually forming a complete prophetic vision."

"The full prophecy finally revealed itself, and Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply in that instant. Chapter Seven Hundred's prophecy was so direct and cruel—'Tianqing Sect Servant Disciple Chen Ji shall be crushed by fate's power on the year's end night, flesh and blood dissolving, soul scattered to nothing, not even Heavenly Secrets can alter this.' The year's end night was three full months away, on New Year's Eve, and that phrase 'not even Heavenly Secrets can alter this' struck like thunder, shattering the last trace of侥幸 in his heart. Mo Xiansheng's residual soul floated above the fragment, the edges of his phantom beginning to show subtle fluctuations, as if even this being accustomed to Heavenly Secrets felt a trace of unease."

dialogue.content: "This chapter of prophecy... is the most resolute verdict this old man has ever witnessed. There is only one triggering condition—the third quarter-hour of midnight on the year's end night. At that moment, fate's power will descend on its own, you will suffer heavenly backlash, and at that moment... everything will end."

text.content: "Chen Ji did not speak. His gaze locked死死 on every character of the prophecy, trying to find some room for maneuver. 'Year's end night'—that time node was too precise, precise enough to make his spine chill; 'Third quarter-hour of midnight'—locked that moment onto fate's scale, without a hair's breadth of deviation. He began calculating rapidly, how many days and nights, how many hours, how many breaths remained until the year's end night, and each calculation made his heart sink deeper. Three months—he only had three months. Mo Xiansheng's phantom watched him quietly, those illusory eyes holding no sympathy, only an indefinable complexity."

"Chen Ji, are you even listening to me? Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a hint of urgency, his residual soul phantom drifting forward a step, nearly touching Chen Ji's cheek. You only have three months, and every time you use the Tianji Record to foresee the future, it consumes your Heavenly Fate Value. You only have one hundred and twenty points remaining, and each use deducts five points... Have you calculated how many more futures you can see? Chen Ji remained silent—of course he had calculated. One hundred and twenty Heavenly Fate points could allow him to窥探 twenty-four more futures. Twenty-four chances, in this chess game destined to fail, like a cup of water against a wildfire."

choice.prompt: "Faced with this near-immutable death prophecy, Chen Ji needed to make a choice:"

choices.text: "Immediately use the Tianji Record to search for a solution"
choices.description: "Although it will consume precious Heavenly Fate Value, time is short, must find clues quickly"
choices.risk_hint: "Heavenly Fate Value is limited, every use is one less"

text.content: "Chen Ji hesitated no longer. He channeled his Heavenly Fate Value into the fragment, and the ghostly blue light blazed again. However, this time the vision he foresaw chilled his heart—he saw his own body lying in a pool of blood, saw Su Qingyao kneeling beside the corpse weeping, saw Ye Qing turning away coldly. Everything was so clear, so immutable."

choices.description: "Do not rush to consume Heavenly Fate Value, instead carefully study every detail of the prophecy, searching for information that might have been overlooked"
choices.risk_hint: "Time is passing, hesitation may miss opportunities"

text.content: "Chen Ji forcibly suppressed his焦躁, refocusing his gaze on the prophecy's original text, examining it word by word. 'Year's end night,' 'third quarter-hour of midnight,' 'fate's power,' 'crushed'... each word was like an iron nail hammered into his coffin. But just as despair threatened to overwhelm him, his gaze suddenly stopped somewhere—the phrasing of the prophecy seemed somehow off."

choices.description: "She is the only one who noticed something wrong with Chen Ji, perhaps she can provide a different perspective"

text.content: "Chen Ji put away the fragment and glided toward the Inner Sect of Tianqing Sect under cover of night. A moment later, he appeared outside Su Qingyao's meditation chamber, gently tapping the window. Su Qingyao's警觉 voice came from within: 'Who?' 'It's me.' Chen Ji said softly, 'Senior Sister Qingyao, I have urgent matters to discuss.' The window opened, and Su Qingyao in her plain white sleeping garment appeared before him, surprise and scrutiny evident in her brow."

"Mo Xiansheng's residual soul phantom hovered in mid-air, sighing幽幽. This old man has witnessed countless prophecies, but never one that pinpointed the timing of death so precisely. 'Third quarter-hour of midnight' means fate's power will descend at that exact moment, not a moment early, not a moment late. Chen Ji's fingers trembled slightly. He suddenly realized something—the prophecy only mentioned 'year's end night' and 'third quarter-hour of midnight,' but did not specify he must be at a particular location on the year's end night. What did this mean? Was fate's pursuit indiscriminate? Or could it be..."

"Chen Ji猛地 raised his head, a flash of sharp light in his eyes. Mo Xiansheng, you said the Tianji Record's prophecies are divided into a thousand chapters, the first seven hundred are destined to happen. But does 'destined' mean absolute certainty, or merely relative probability? He walked quickly to the fragment, fingers brushing across those cold characters, mind racing. The prophecy said 'on the year's end night,' but what if he wasn't at Tianqing Sect? What if he was in Holy Sect territory, or even within some Ancient Forbidden Land? Could heavenly will精准 descend fate's power in those places as well?"

dialogue.content: "This question hits the mark. Mo Xiansheng's phantom微微颔首, a flash of approval in his eyes. Heavenly will's power is not omnipresent. It needs a medium, needs at specific times, specific locations,借助 specific conditions to descend. If you leave Tianqing Sect, the prophecy's precision will surely diminish."

text.content: "A spark of hope燃起 in Chen Ji's eyes, but was quickly replaced by another worry. Even if the prophecy's precision would decrease, he dared not let his guard down. After all, the prophecy explicitly said 'fate's power' rather than 'Tianqing Sect's power,' meaning the executor could be heavenly will itself or its avatar, not merely a mortal like Ling Yuan. He summoned the world's map from memory, calculating rapidly—how much time from current location to the nearest forbidden land, whether he could arrive before the year's end night, whether there were sufficient concealment conditions there, and... whether his Heavenly Fate Value was enough to sustain the journey's consumption."

choice.prompt: "After preliminary analysis, Chen Ji had several possible directions:"

choices.text: "Immediately depart for the East Sea Forbidden Land"
choices.description: "Ancient Forbidden Lands contain mysterious powers that may be sufficient to interfere with heavenly will's perception"
choices.risk_hint: "Forbidden Lands are dangerous, too many unknown factors"

text.content: "Chen Ji made his decision. He packed his belongings overnight, concealed the Tianji Record Fragment close to his body, and quietly left Tianqing Sect under cover of night. However, the moment he scaled the back mountain, a凌厉 sword energy suddenly came from behind—Su Qingyao had somehow caught up, white robes billowing, sword pointing at Chen Ji's back. 'Chen Ji, where are you going?' Her voice was cold, 'What crime merits privately descending the mountain at night?'"

choices.text: "First contact Demon Path Saintess Ye Qing"
choices.description: "Her Demon Path mist can conceal the Tianji Record's aura, perhaps helping to evade fate's pursuit"
choices.risk_hint: "Association with the Demon Path, once exposed, will make one a target for all"

text.content: "Chen Ji drew out a pitch-black communication talisman from his怀, this was a secret communication item between him and Ye Qing. Upon talisman activation, Ye Qing's cold voice sounded in his ear: 'Chen Ji? Contacting me this late—something wrong?' Chen Ji did not hide anything, briefly informing her of the death prophecy he faced. After a moment of silence, Ye Qing's voice returned, carrying an unusual gravity: 'I understand. Demon Path mist can indeed conceal heavenly aura, but a carrier is needed... You must come to Holy Sect in person.'"

choices.description: "Since fate comes to me, I'll prepare a 'surprise' for it on the year's end night"

text.content: "A cold smile slowly curved Chen Ji's lips. Since the Death Executor was already en route, he would prepare a 'surprise' for them. He began secretly laying formation arrays throughout Tianqing Sect, while contacting all forces he could rally—Ye Qing's Demon Path mist, Su Qingyao's protection, even Han Lie's brute-force countermeasures... He would turn the year's end night into a counter-hunt against fate itself. Mo Xiansheng静静地看着 him, a complex light flickering in his eyes, seeming to want to say something, yet forcibly holding back."

"However, whichever path he chose, Chen Ji knew one thing—he must understand more details about Chapter Seven Hundred's prophecy before then. He turned his gaze to the fragment once more. This time, he paid no attention to the prophecy's main text, but began examining character by character the structure of each word, the brushstrokes, even the depth of the ink. The Tianji Record never writes a single unnecessary character, nor ever omits one. Every character exists for a reason. He suddenly discovered a subtle anomaly—the final phrase '纵天机亦不可改' (not even Heavenly Secrets can alter this), the character '亦' (also), its brushstroke seemed slightly different from the other characters—somewhat hurried, somewhat pale."

"Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. He reached out his finger, gently brushing the ink of that '亦' character. A strange sensation transmitted from his fingertip—this character was not original Tianji Record writing, but had been tampered with and added later. He猛地 raised his head, looking at Mo Xiansheng's phantom, voice carrying a tremor: 'Mo Xiansheng, this character '亦'... was not written by the Tianji Record, was it?' Mo Xiansheng's residual soul remained silent for a moment, then slowly nodded: 'Discovered, are you... You truly are the one the Tianji Record chose. This character, I added it.' Chen Ji's heart raced wildly. He stared死死 at Mo Xiansheng's phantom, awaiting the continuation."

dialogue.content: "The original text had only four characters—'纵天机改' (even Heavenly Secrets can alter). I changed it to '纵天机亦不可改' (not even Heavenly Secrets can alter)... This was to mislead certain... people who should not窥探 Heavenly Secrets. Mo Xiansheng's phantom drifted and flickered, his voice carrying exhaustion. Those original four characters were the real loophole. '纵天机改'—this means as long as you are strong enough, even the Tianji Record's prophecy can be changed by your own hands."

text.content: "Chen Ji was stunned. Fate gave him three months, the Tianji Record gave him a '亦' character of misdirection, and Mo Xiansheng was the Chess Player watching over this game from the shadows. He took a deep breath, erasing that tampered '亦' character from his memory, re-examining the prophecy's true meaning—'Tianqing Sect Servant Disciple Chen Ji shall be crushed by fate's power on the year's end night, flesh and blood dissolving, soul scattered to nothing, even Heavenly Secrets can alter.' He suddenly laughed, laughter echoing through the silent night, carrying bitterness, resignation, and more than anything, a resolve to burn every bridge. Since even Heavenly Secrets can be altered, he would alter them, right before your eyes."
